name: Embodied Visual Tracking Benchmark (EVT-Bench)
description: EVT-Bench is a large-scale benchmark dataset for embodied visual tracking, designed to evaluate models on the task of following a specific target in dynamic environments using egocentric vision. It includes diverse difficulty levels and 1.7 million samples to test recognition and trajectory planning under occlusion and high scene dynamics.
reputation: A recent research benchmark from the embodied AI literature that is gaining attention for evaluating visual tracking in realistic, dynamic first-person settings.
notes: Constructed dataset with diverse difficulty levels; demonstrates strong generalizability and zero-shot performance; runs at 10 FPS inference speed.
